name: Settlement exception worklist
summary: When the settlement report shows unmatched or failed items, your operations lead gets one aged worklist: each trade's terms, confirmation status, supplied instruction and custodian differences side by side, with a proposed owner. The lead validates and assigns; nothing is sent or moved.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of settlement exception work for advisory and investment firms, and its own rules for prepared work: the firm's exports as the only source, named column headings with a stop when one does not match, every difference listed beside its evidence, and a person who validates, assigns and approves.
